items.title: The Oklahoma City Blue (Thunder's G League affiliate) acquired Killian Hayes' G League rights. I won't be surprised if an Exhibit 10 deal with the Thunder is coming for Hayes, then he lands with the Blue to start this season.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
